items: 🍀【Dainty & Elegant Design】♡-Featuring a delicate oval case (just 25*19mm wide) and soft golden hue, Our small womens watch pairs effortlessly with both casual wear and formal attire;⭐ it will ensure your wrist stands out whether you're enjoying a leisurely walk or attending a glamorous gala. The ideal gift for the special woman in your life.

🍀【Comfort-Fit Stainless Steel Expansion Band】✧- Discover the ideal fusion of style and comfort with our ladies watches, featuring a sleek, polished stainless steel expansion band.⭐Its stretchable and flexible design allows for easy donning and removal, ensuring durability and long-wearing comfort.

🍀【Easy Read Dial】♡-The dial features small yet clear numbers and hands, ensuring effortless readability at a glance.⭐Thanks to its photoluminescent properties, womens watch face absorbs ambient light during the day, enabling clear visibility even in low-light settings—perfect for nighttime use or in dimly lit surroundings.

🍀【5ATM Water-Resistant Performance】✧-VTAIGE gold womens watch is water-resistant up to 165 feet (50 meters/5ATM), making it suitable for everyday activities such as handwashing, light rain, and accidental splashes.⭐ For long-lasting performance, we recommend avoiding prolonged submersion in water, hot showers, saunas, or high-pressure water exposure (e.g., diving or swimming).

🍀【Chic Gifts for Women】♡- With its elegant design and precise craftsmanship, our women's wrist watch is an ideal gift for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, parties, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas, New Year and other special holidays.⭐ Surprise your loved one with this timeless symbol of emotion.
